promise: "We will pursue our manifest destiny into the stars, launching American astronauts to plant the Stars and Stripes on the planet Mars."
description: In his second inaugural address Trump pledged to launch American astronauts to plant the US flag on Mars, a goal he first tied to the end of his term at an October 2024 rally. As of August 2026 no crewed Mars mission was scheduled, and orbital dynamics mean a landing could not occur before 2029 at the earliest.
evidence: No crewed Mars mission approved or scheduled as of mid-2026
NYT analysis: a Mars landing cannot happen before 2029 due to orbital windows
